procedure: Header stacks and cell values read from page renders (page.crop().to_image), 800-1300 dpi zooms per cell cluster, saved under cache/2026-general-text/header-strips/ (jas_*). Labels read left-to-right per page; every candidate's cells verified against the printed county TOTAL.
extraction_note: Phase C gate runs under THIS text layer fail for structural reasons documented in the Task 8 report (cache/2026-general-text/jasper_gate_fuzzyoff.txt, jasper_gate_fuzzyon.txt): p2 detects only 7 of 11 columns (grid_centers' anchor-span filter drops the left clusters because the first data line's OCR digits are incomplete), p3's table top lands at y=308 (Guest's row) so the four candidates above it lose their Rose Hill/Stringer/TOTAL cells, p4's grid is lost entirely (no x cluster reaches the 3-member floor; 17 clean numeric tokens on the whole page among 11 columns), and p5 finds no table top - so the Circuit Court 13 Place 2 row (Stanley Sorey) is unrecoverable from this layer, which is why the county must not write a CSV until a re-extraction (operator vision sweep or PaddleOCR) supplies the cells. The printed document itself is fully self-consistent: every candidate's p2/p4 cells plus p3/p5 cells sum exactly to the printed county TOTAL (all 11 verified from renders).
structure_note: Column-split pagination like Warren: p2+p3 are one logical table (13 columns = 12 precincts + TOTAL; p2 = columns 1-11 Antioch..Paulding, p3 = columns 12-13 Rose Hill, Stringer + TOTAL), and p4+p5 are a SECOND such table for the Circuit Court 13 Place 2 section (p4 = columns 1-11, p5 = Rose Hill, Stringer + TOTAL). Each race section's row prints in full under BOTH column sets with the office headers reprinted on every page. p2's vertical name stacks print bottom-aligned (Antioch, Bay Springs Beat 3, Bay Springs Beat 4, Claiborne, Heidelberg, Holders, Louin, Montrose, Moss, Moss East, Paulding); p3/p5's tail stacks are Rose Hill, Stringer, TOTAL. p1 is the certification cover page (Official Recapitulation 2026 General Election, no table) and yields a garbage one-cluster extraction on this OCR text layer. p4/p5 are the only pages that reach the Circuit Court 13-Place 2 row (Stanley Sorey), so they must stay declared even though their text layer is unreadable - undeclared they would silently drop the county's only Place 2 candidate.
truncation_note: No page-edge truncations on this document: Moss East is a complete printed name visible on p2 (also p4), new vs the county's 2026 primary precinct list (20260310__ms__primary__jasper__precinct.csv, 12 precincts); every other spelling matches the primary/2024 general lists.
